title: Negative slice of the optimality function
statement: For every $q\in\mathbb N$, fixing the first coordinate of the real-valued sign embedding of the optimality Boolean function to $-1$ gives the function $x\mapsto 2A_q(x)-1$, where $A_q$ is the small-set indicator on the tail coordinates.
